title: Acoustic re-identification research
description: Research software for recording-context diagnostics in acoustic animal re-identification. Version 0.2.1 documents the completed cached-vector verification audit and links the independent v8 evidence deposit. It includes the tied-score correction and independent local archiving introduced in 0.2.0. All reported paired-clip EERs and headline classifications are reproduced without new model inference. Apache-2.0 applies to software; manuscript and evidence documentation are CC BY-NC 4.0; third-party terms remain separate.
